# Security policy

[Русская версия](SECURITY.ru.md)

Report vulnerabilities privately to **Ivan Zorin**, <creator@localzet.com>. Include the PHP, Cluster and Server versions, reproduction steps and expected behavior. Do not post live secrets or user data in public issues.

Fixes are verified on the current default branch; a separate maintenance policy for older releases has not been established. Shared-secret authentication does not encrypt transport. Restrict discovery and internal gateway ports to trusted hosts.
